name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
benefit: ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments
description: PM-KISAN is a Central Sector scheme with 100% funding from Government of India. It provides income support to all landholding farmers' families in the country.

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
department: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
benefit: Health insurance cover of up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year
description: The world's largest health insurance/ assurance scheme fully financed by the government. It provides a cover of Rs. 5 lakhs per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
benefit: Subsidy on home loan interest rates up to 6.5%
description: Aimed at providing housing for all in urban areas. Provides central assistance to implementing agencies through States/UTs for providing houses to all eligible families/beneficiaries.

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
benefit: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month
description: A pension scheme for citizens of India focused on the unorganized sector workers. Under APY, guaranteed minimum pension is given at the age of 60 years depending on the contributions.

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
department: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
benefit: Financial support of ₹1600 for LPG connection
description: A scheme to distribute 50 million LPG connections to women of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families to replace unclean cooking fuels.

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana
benefit: High interest rate savings account for girl child
description: A government of India backed saving scheme targeted at the parents of girl children. The scheme encourages parents to build a fund for the future education and marriage expenses for their female child.

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
description: An Indian labour law and social security measure that aims to guarantee the 'right to work' by providing at least 100 days of wage employment in a financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.

name: Bhamashah Yojana (Jan Aadhaar)
benefit: Direct benefit transfer to women head of family
description: A scheme introduced by the Government of Rajasthan to transfer financial and non-financial benefits of government schemes directly to women recipients in a transparent way.

name: Mukhyamantri Chiranjeevi Swasthya Bima Yojana
department: Department of Medical, Health and Family Welfare
description: A universal health insurance scheme for all families of Rajasthan providing cashless treatment up to Rs 25 Lakh in government and empanelled private hospitals.

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana
benefit: Loans up to ₹10 Lakhs for micro/small enterprises
description: PMMY is a scheme launched by the Hon'ble Prime Minister for providing loans up to 10 lakh to the non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
